dataset.name: Danish road user charge (vejbenyttelsesafgift, Eurovignette)
dataset.method: Lov om afgift af vejbenyttelse, LBK nr. 174 af 24/02/2020, § 3, stk. 4, nr. 5: 89 kroner a day for trucks registered abroad of 12 t or more, whatever their emission norm and axles; § 4 adjusts the amounts each 1 January only if the euro's value in kroner has changed by 5% or more. The period starts at the start of a day (§ 2, stk. 5). The law ended on 1 January 2025 (lov nr. 763 af 13/06/2023), replaced by the km-based vejafgift.
dataset.publisher: carbon-cost (majidkabir/carbon-cost), compiled from the sources listed

sources.title: Lov om afgift af vejbenyttelse, LBK nr. 174 af 24/02/2020 (Retsinformation)

vehicles.description: Trucks and combinations registered abroad of 12 t or more total weight
